# BVLVO — The Economic Layer for Personal AI

BVLVO is a research initiative exploring the economic protocols for persistent Personal AI — identity, capability, authority, trust and useful work.

## Current Phase: Research Validation
The first theoretical framework has been established. Current work is focused on formal definitions, prior-art validation and rigorous experimental methodology for persistent Personal AI.
- Framework: Research Draft.
- Paper 01, Principal-Need-Shaped Personal AI: Methodology Validation.
- Paper 02, Bounded Autonomy for Personal AI: Research Draft.
- Paper 03, Machine Trust Without a Universal Reputation Score: Research Draft.
- Planned research is not published research. Exploratory simulations are completed. Methodology is under validation. Confirmatory experiments are not completed; real-human longitudinal validation is not established. Pilot results calibrate methodology and do not confirm the theory.

## Boundaries
Adopted principles do not establish originality. Related work overlap does not settle whole-proposal originality; absence of a found precedent does not establish originality. Technical mechanisms and full manuscripts are reserved for separate reviewed releases. No final specification, legal clearance, production audit or robot compatibility is claimed.
BVLVO is researching a native economic medium for Personal AI work, capabilities, machine resources and verification. No official mainnet asset exists. No public sale is currently being offered.
Earlier experimental work informed the current research direction; archived dates and parameters are not current commitments.
